messages.subject: 2025 Summer Analyst Program - Morgan Stanley (HOU)
messages.body:
Hey Jonathan,

I hope all is well. I'm an analyst here at Morgan Stanley Houston and fellow Longhorn reaching out to see if you were interested in learning more about the 2025 Summer Analyst process. Let me know if you have a window to chat later this week or next.

Thanks, and hope to talk soon.

Grant

Grant Gillespie, Analyst
Morgan Stanley | Investment Banking Division
600 Travis Street, Suite 3700, 37th Floor | Houston, TX 77002
Phone: +1 713 512-4501
Mobile: +1 917 923-6022
Grant.Gillespie@morganstanley.com<mailto:Grant.Gillespie@morganstanley.com>

messages.subject: Re: 2025 Summer Analyst Program - Morgan Stanley (HOU)
messages.body:
Grant – I greatly appreciate you spending the time to hop on the phone with
me this afternoon. Your insight not only into Morgan Stanley, but also
general advice on the recruitment process is super valuable to me. To that
end, Morgan Stanley sounds like a very exciting firm, and I certainly would
like to continue pursuing this avenue. If you have anybody else in your
office that would make sense to talk to, I would greatly appreciate it if
you could pass along their contact info as I aim to continue networking and
learn more. Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan
